escena: SCENE (craft brewery office, late afternoon, the team checks the first week of a launch campaign): in focus, a growth analyst in a plain charcoal overshirt stands at a tall desk and leans in CLOSE to an open laptop raised on a stand at face height, the index finger touching the screen right on the rising line of a chart; the cool blue light of the laptop screen is the brightest thing in the frame and lifts the analyst's face and hand. A small lime-green sticky note on the laptop's bezel marks the target that was just reached. Behind, SOFT and out of focus, stacked brewery crates and a window with warm dusk light. 85mm f/1.8. LENS FRAMING (essential, compact): the analyst's face, the pointing finger and the laptop screen are CLOSE TOGETHER, all three inside ONE circle whose diameter is about 75% of the frame height, centred at 72% of the frame width and at mid height, with air around it; nothing essential outside that circle. The LEFT 45% of the frame holds only a calm, evenly shadowed brick wall. Nobody looks at the lens. No readable text or numbers on the screen, completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the dark oiled-wood edge of the tall desk right at the lens

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed brick wall
